items.name: Blade of Despair
items.passive: Despair: Dealing damage to enemies in abnormal state increases Physical Attack by 25% for 2s.
items.function: Item serangan fisik tertinggi di game. Cocok untuk hero yang bisa memicu CC atau melawan hero yang punya status effect.

items.name: Berserker's Fury
items.passive: Doom: Critical hits increase Physical Attack by 40% for 2s.
items.function: Meningkatkan critical strike damage. Wajib untuk Marksman yang mengandalkan critical hit.

items.name: Windtalker
items.passive: Every 3 basic attacks trigger a gust dealing magic damage to 3 enemies.
items.function: Item serangan kecepatan untuk Marksman. Efektif untuk wave clear dan AoE damage ringan.

items.name: Scarlet Phantom
items.passive: Frenzy: Critical hits increase Attack Speed by 30% and Critical Chance by 5% for 2s.
items.function: Memicu frenzy saat critical. Digunakan bersama Berserker's Fury untuk build full critical Marksman.

items.name: Malefic Roar
items.passive: Armor Buster: Physical PEN increases by 0.1% for every 1 Physical DEF the target has, max 20%.
items.function: Item penetrasi armor terbaik. Counter hero tank atau hero dengan Physical DEF tinggi.

items.name: Demon Hunter Sword
items.passive: Devour: Basic attacks deal 9% of target's current HP as additional physical damage.
items.function: Counter hero HP tinggi (tank/fighter). Efektif karena damage berdasarkan HP current musuh.

items.name: Golden Staff
items.passive: Swift: Every basic attack stack Swift. At 2 stacks, next attack triggers unique effect twice.
items.function: Sangat kuat dengan hero yang punya efek serangan basic unik (Karrie, Wanwan, Masha).

items.name: Corrosion Scythe
items.passive: Corrosion: Basic attacks slow enemy movement by 8%, stackable up to 5 times.
items.function: Memberikan slow pada musuh lewat basic attack. Bagus untuk kiting dan chase.

items.name: Haas's Claws
items.passive: Insanity: When HP < 50%, gain additional 15% Physical Lifesteal.
items.function: Item lifesteal utama. Memberikan sustain dalam pertarungan panjang untuk Fighter dan Marksman.

items.name: Endless Battle
items.passive: Divine Justice: After using skill, next basic attack deals 60% Physical Attack as True Damage.
items.function: Item serba ada untuk Fighter. True damage dari basic attack pasca skill sangat efektif.

items.name: Hunter Strike
items.passive: Nimble: After hitting enemy with skill 5 times, gain 30% Movement Speed for 3s.
items.function: Item CDR dan burst. Cocok untuk hero assassin yang perlu kejar musuh.

items.name: Blade of the Heptaseas
items.passive: Ambush: If no damage in 5s, next basic attack deals bonus Physical Damage.
items.function: Memberikan burst damage dari basic attack setelah idle. Cocok untuk Assassin yang mengintai.

items.name: War Axe
items.passive: Fighting Spirit: Each second in combat stacks Physical Attack and Physical Penetration, max 8 stacks.
items.function: Item terbaik untuk Fighter EXP lane. Semakin lama fight, semakin kuat hero yang memakainya.

items.name: Calamity Reaper
items.passive: Calamity: After casting skill, next basic attack deals True Damage equal to 120% Base ATK + 15% Magic Power.
items.function: Memberikan true damage lewat basic attack. Cocok untuk mage yang sering pakai basic attack (Harley, Cyclops).

items.name: Lightning Truncheon
items.passive: Resonate: Every 6s, next skill bounces lightning to max 3 enemies dealing 20-1000 Magic Damage.
items.function: Memberikan damage AoE dari mana. Cocok untuk mage yang sering casting (Cecilion, Cyclops).

items.name: Holy Crystal
items.passive: Mystery: Magic Attack is increased by 21-35% (scales with level).
items.function: Item magic power pure terkuat. Wajib untuk mage burst yang butuh damage tinggi di late game.

items.name: Divine Glaive
items.passive: Spellbreaker: For every 50 Magic Defense enemy has, gain extra 4% Magic Penetration, max 20%.
items.function: Counter hero dengan Magic DEF tinggi. Wajib ketika musuh beli banyak item magic resist.

items.name: Glowing Wand
items.passive: Scorch: Deals burn damage equal to 1.5% of target's max HP per second for 3s (max 60 on minions).
items.function: Counter hero HP tinggi dengan burn damage. Juga memberikan sedikit survivability dari HP bonus.

items.name: Ice Queen Wand
items.passive: Ice Bound: Skills slow enemy movement by 15%, stackable up to 2 times.
items.function: Mage utility dengan slow. Sangat efektif untuk mage yang butuh chase musuh atau mencegah escape.

items.name: Necklace of Durance
items.passive: Life Drain: Reduces shield and regen effect of hit enemies by 50% for 3s.
items.function: Counter hero lifesteal dan heal. Wajib melawan Estes, Alice, Uranus, atau hero dengan sustain tinggi.

items.name: Genius Wand
items.passive: Magic: Dealing damage reduces target's Magic DEF by 3-10, stacks up to 3 times.
items.function: Item poke mage terbaik. Semakin sering hit, semakin berkurang DEF musuh. Cocok untuk Harley, Lylia.

items.name: Blood Wings
items.passive: Covenant: Adds 1.5 HP for every 1 point of Magic Power.
items.function: Item late game mage untuk HP dan damage. Sangat efektif saat sudah full build magic power.

items.name: Fleeting Time
items.passive: Timestream: After killing hero/assist, reduce ultimate cooldown by 30%.
items.function: Mage dengan ultimate kuat bisa spam ultimate lebih sering. Cocok untuk Kagura, Luo Yi, Aurora.

items.name: Concentrated Energy
items.passive: Recharge: Killing enemy hero restores 10% HP.
items.function: Memberikan sustain mage lewat magic lifesteal dan HP restore. Cocok untuk mage tempur (Alice).

items.name: Immortality
items.passive: Immortal: Upon death, resurrect after 2.5s with 15% HP and shield absorbing 300-1000 damage.
items.function: Item cheat mati. Cocok untuk semua hero terutama carry yang ingin extra safety di teamfight.

items.name: Antique Cuirass
items.passive: Deter: Being hit by enemy skill reduces their Physical Attack by 10% for 2s, stackable up to 3 times.
items.function: Tank terbaik untuk counter Physical Damage. Semakin sering di-hit skill musuh, semakin berkurang ATK mereka.

items.name: Blade Armor
items.passive: Vengeance: Reflects 25% of Physical Damage taken back as physical damage.
items.function: Counter Marksman dan hero basic attack. Semakin tinggi ATK musuh, semakin besar damage balik.

items.name: Warrior Boots
items.passive: Valor: Gains 5 Physical Defense with each basic attack hit, max 25, lasts 3s.
items.function: Boots untuk menghadapi hero physical. Memberikan Physical DEF adaptif saat kena serangan.

items.name: Tough Boots
items.passive: Fortitude: Reduces time of Crowd Control effects by 30%.
items.function: Boots untuk menghadapi mage atau hero CC berat. Mengurangi durasi stun, slow, dll.

items.name: Athena's Shield
items.passive: Shield: Takes Magic Damage to trigger a shield absorbing 170-1150 Magic Damage (scales with level). Cooldown 30s.
items.function: Counter mage burst. Shield-nya bisa absorb banyak damage magic terutama di late game.

items.name: Radiant Armor
items.passive: Holy Blessing: After being hit by magic damage 5 times, increases Magic DEF by 3-10 per second for 6s.
items.function: Counter mage yang menggunakan DoT (Glowing Wand). Semakin sering kena magic, semakin tangguh.

items.name: Cursed Helmet
items.passive: Burning Soul: Deals magic damage equal to 1.5% of max HP per second to nearby enemies.
items.function: Tank dengan damage AoE pasif. Efektif untuk jungler atau tank yang selalu terlibat teamfight.

items.name: Dominance Ice
items.passive: Arctic Cold: Reduces Movement Speed by 5% and Attack Speed of nearby enemies by 30%. Also reduces shield and HP regen of nearby enemies by 50%.
items.function: Counter Marksman dan hero dengan heal/shield. Aura slow attack speed sangat efektif di teamfight.

items.name: Queen's Wings
items.passive: Demonize: When HP falls below 40%, reduces damage taken by 40% and increases Lifesteal by 30% for 5s. CD: 60s.
items.function: Item survival Fighter saat HP rendah. Sangat efektif untuk hero yang bisa comeback dari HP sedikit.

items.name: Brute Force Breastplate
items.passive: Brute Force: Using skill or basic attack increases Movement Speed by 3% and Physical/Magic DEF by 4, stackable 5 times for 4s.
items.function: Item tank yang semakin kuat saat aktif bertarung. Cocok untuk tank/fighter yang agresif.

items.name: Thunderbelt
items.passive: Thunderbolt: After using skill, next basic attack slows enemy and deals True Damage equal to 50 + 5% of Max HP.
items.function: Item tank yang memberikan true damage. Cocok untuk tank aktif seperti Tigreal, Akai, Atlas.

items.name: Oracle
items.passive: Bless: Increases Shield Absorption and HP Regen effects by 30%.
items.function: Meningkatkan efek heal dan shield. Wajib untuk Estes, Rafaela, atau hero dengan sustain kemampuan diri sendiri.

items.name: Twilight Armor
items.passive: Twilight: When taking Physical Damage exceeding 600, caps the damage at 900 + 5% Max HP. CD: 5s.
items.function: Counter burst Physical damage. Ideal melawan Saber, Gusion, atau hero yang bisa one-shot.

items.name: Windbreaker
items.passive: Gale: Grants a shield absorbing 500-2000 damage every 24s (scales with Physical DEF) when attacked.
items.function: Shield periodik yang kuat untuk tank. Sangat efektif di fase early-mid game teamfight.

items.name: Sea Halberd
items.passive: Lifebane: Hitting enemy reduces their HP Regen and Shield by 50% for 3s.
items.function: Counter hero dengan heal seperti Uranus, Thamuz, atau hero pakai Haas's Claws + Oracle.

items.name: Wind of Nature
items.active: Wind Chant: Become immune to Physical Damage for 2s. CD: 80s.
items.function: Item aktif memberikan invincibility dari Physical Damage. Counter assassin atau burst physical.

items.name: Starlium Scythe
items.passive: Stardust: After casting skill, next basic attack deals 100 extra magic damage + slow 30% for 1.5s.
items.function: Item CDR dan poke untuk mage. Extra slow dari basic attack membantu kontrol pergerakan musuh.

items.name: Feather of Heaven
items.passive: Typhoon: Basic attacks deal extra magic damage equal to 40% Magic Power.
items.function: Item hybrid mage-attacker. Cocok untuk mage yang menggunakan basic attack banyak (Lylia, Cyclops).

items.name: Clock of Destiny
items.passive: Time: Every 30s gains 30 Max HP and 5 Magic Attack, stackable up to 12 times.
items.function: Item yang semakin kuat seiring waktu. Beli early game agar bisa max stack di mid-late game.

items.name: Enchanted Talisman
items.passive: Mana Spring: Restores 15% total Mana every 10s.
items.function: Item CDR dan mana regen. Ideal untuk mage yang boros mana (Eudora, Aurora, Vexana).

items.name: Despair Blade
items.passive: Despair Strike: Dealing damage to stunned/immobilized enemy increases Physical Penetration by 15% for 3s.
items.function: Memberikan true penetrasi saat musuh terkena CC. Sinergi baik dengan hero yang punya CC diri sendiri.

items.name: Rose Gold Meteor
items.passive: Lifeline: When HP falls below 30%, grants a shield absorbing 510-1350 damage. CD: 40s.
items.function: Item survival Marksman atau Assassin. Shield saat HP kritis sangat membantu untuk survive burst.

items.name: Rapid Boots
items.passive: Activate: Grants huge Movement Speed boost out of combat.
items.function: Boots tercepat. Cocok untuk roamer atau jungler yang butuh mobilitas tinggi antar lane.

items.name: Magic Shoes
items.passive: None
items.function: Boots untuk mage atau hero yang butuh CDR. Memungkinkan spam skill lebih sering.

items.name: Arcane Boots
items.passive: None
items.function: Boots penetrasi magic. Cocok untuk mage yang butuh menembus Magic Defense musuh.
